experiment_data.hypothesis: Frozen dt_emb (random init, no gradients) prevents CIVO by blocking the trained-embedding-driven value overestimation feedback loop, while the learned gate (Gumbel-softmax, receives gradients) retains adaptive horizon selection capability. If successful, this decouples temporal abstraction benefits from CIVO vulnerability.
experiment_data.parent: exp_008f_s3_no_dt_embed_walker + exp_005_gate_arch (combines safe dt_emb from 008f with gate architecture from 005 series)
experiment_data.failure_reason: Config error: used --configs dmc_vision (CNN+image, wrong modality) instead of dmc_proprio, and --compile True (torch.compile inductor crash). Killed and resubmitting with correct config.
